findings.current: “May the Lord of Heaven be with us……!”
findings.defect: Turns the fanatic’s assertion into a wish, weakening the setup for “Who’s with you?”
findings.rationale: The Korean begins a declaration that the Lord of Heaven is with them, not a prayer that he might be.
findings.replacement: “The Lord of Heaven is with us……!”

findings.current: The defensive formation protecting her and the hundred or so mages around her had been as solid as an iron wall.
findings.defect: Counts the Grand Mage separately from the hundred or so mages instead of including her among them.
findings.rationale: 그녀를 비롯한 makes her part of the group of roughly one hundred mages.
findings.replacement: The enemy’s defensive formation around the hundred or so mages, including her, had been as solid as an iron wall.
findings.source: 그녀를 비롯한 일백여 명의 술사들을 지키는 적들의 방어진은 철벽처럼 두터웠고
